description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour class 'DefaultTrackableEventHandler' that implements Vuforia's ITrackableEventHandler interface to handle tracking state changes of AR trackables, enabling or disabling rendering, colliders, and canvases accordingly.

classes.name: DefaultTrackableEventHandler
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class that handles Vuforia trackable state changes to toggle visibility and interaction components.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the TrackableBehaviour component and registers the event handler.

methods.name: OnTrackableStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in tracking state, calling appropriate methods based on the new status.

methods.name: OnTrackingFound
methods.description: Enables rendering, colliders, and canvases for the tracked object.

methods.name: OnTrackingLost
methods.description: Disables rendering, colliders, and canvases when tracking is lost.
